data.bottom_line: A relatively shallow and stable snowpack exists across the forecast zone, with the exception of high alpine terrain. Avalanche danger will likely rise over the coming days with the arrival of wind and snow. Watch for the five red flags of avalanche danger and remember when snow is the problem, terrain is the solution. Daily avalanche forecasts will begin December 1. In the meantime, we will update this advisory and the observations page as conditions warrant.
